papers.title_en: Elastic Resistance Bands in Sports Medicine and Rehabilitation: A Narrative Review of Neuromuscular Mechanisms, Prescription, and Functional Applications
papers.title_zh: 运动医学与康复中的弹力带：神经肌肉机制、处方和功能应用的叙述性综述
papers.tldr_en: Evidence is more established for improvements in muscular strength and functional performance than for direct reductions in injury incidence or successful return-to-sport outcomes, and its effectiveness depends on explicit load quantification, individualized progression, appropriate exercise configuration, and transparent reporting of intervention parameters.
papers.abstract_en: Background/Objectives: Elastic resistance bands are widely used in rehabilitation, injury prevention, and athletic conditioning because they are portable, inexpensive, and adaptable to multiple movement planes. However, their mechanical behavior and training dose are often insufficiently characterized. This structured narrative review aimed to synthesize current evidence on the neuromuscular mechanisms, prescription principles, and functional applications of elastic resistance bands in sports medicine and rehabilitation. Methods: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and ScienceDirect were searched from inception to 31 May 2026. Peer-reviewed human studies and reviews were included when they addressed mechanical, neuromuscular, biomechanical, prescriptive, rehabilitative, injury-prevention, or performance-related aspects of elastic resistance exercise. papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：弹力带因其便携、经济且适用于多种运动平面，在康复、损伤预防和运动训练中得到广泛应用。然而，其力学行为和训练剂量常未得到充分表征。本结构化叙述性综述旨在综合当前关于弹力带在运动医学和康复中的神经肌肉机制、处方原则和功能应用的证据。方法：对PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和ScienceDirect进行了检索。

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 可穿戴传感器步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：损伤预防与康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动员表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。尽管传统的实验室评估提供了见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态有效环境中进行客观、实时的步态评估提供了新的机会。本系统综述旨在 (1) 评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，(2) 考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及 (3) 识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：离心阻力训练被认为是增强成年人肌肉力量和爆发力指标的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚未被充分了解。目的：本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法：检索了1950年至2022年6月间发表的原始期刊文章，通过电子搜索引擎...

papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂结合体能训练对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉量的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求的不可或缺的一部分，对其性能影响的研究也日益增多。然而，不一致的研究结果使得某些补充剂（最著名的是支链氨基酸和β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸盐（HMB））的功效仍存在争议。为了阐明哪些产品能带来最大益处，我们进行了一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析，旨在确定对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素D、咖啡因等。方法：Pub...

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 撰写高质量运动科学案例研究
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes.
